title: Supported affine extension of a stabilized overlap
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-separated scheme [def-pc-scheme], $W\subseteq X$ a compact open, $V\subseteq X$ affine open, and $T\subseteq X$ closed with compact complement. Choose derived localizations [def-pc-derived-category] in the same Hom universe $w$ on $W,V$ and their localized open sites and on $W\cap V$. Let $F\in D(\mathcal O_W)$ be perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex], with every cohomology stalk vanishing on $W\setminus T$. Let $S_W,S_V$ be the canonical transported overlap restrictions [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps]. There is a perfect $Q\in D(\mathcal O_V)$ supported on $T\cap V$, meaning all cohomology stalks vanish on $V\setminus T$, together with an isomorphism $S_VQ\cong S_W(F\oplus F[1])$. No map into a target object is asserted.

proof.text: Obtain compact-open supported restriction data from exists_supported_overlap_restriction_data. Install its chosen localization on U and on all localized open sites. Apply exists_perfect_supported_extension on the affine scheme V.toScheme with closed set the inverse image of T. Its output Q is perfect with the required support. Its restriction isomorphism is mapped through e and composed with the two restriction comparisons to give SV(Q) isomorphic to SW(F plus F[1]).

mathlib_searches.query: Restriction to an open subscheme preserves locally perfect complexes and vanishing homology stalks; affine supported extension plus shift
A perfect complex restricts to a perfect complex on an open subscheme; the direct sum with its shift has the same closed support.

lean.statement: theorem exists_supported_overlap_perfect_extension (X : Scheme.{u}) [QuasiSeparatedSpace X] (W V : X.Opens) (hW : IsCompact (W : Set X)) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (T : Set X) (hT : IsClosed T) (hTc : IsCompact Tᶜ) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace))] [∀ O : W.toScheme.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace).over O))] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace))] [∀ O : V.toScheme.Opens, HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace).over O))] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (W ⊓ V).toScheme.toRingedSpace))] (F : schemeDerivedCategory W.toScheme) (hF : IsPerfect W.toScheme F) (hFT : (∀ (i : ℤ) (x : W.toScheme), x.val ∉ T → Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings W.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) i).obj F).val.presheaf x)))) : let SW := (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction X (homOfLE inf_le_left : W ⊓ V ⟶ W)).mapDerivedCategory let SV := (schemeOpenOverlapRestriction X (homOfLE inf_le_right : W ⊓ V ⟶ V)).mapDerivedCategory ∃ Q : schemeDerivedCategory V.toScheme, IsPerfect V.toScheme Q ∧ (∀ (i : ℤ) (x : V.toScheme), x.val ∉ T → Subsingleton (↑(TopCat.Presheaf.stalk ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings V.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) i).obj Q).val.presheaf x))) ∧ Nonempty (SV.obj Q ≅ SW.obj (F ⊞ F⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧))
